images.title: Compare the price of 1 kg
images.purpose: Shows five 200 g packets making 1 kg for ₹1000 beside one 1 kg packet for ₹800, so the first tea is dearer.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two groups side by side with lots of space between them: five small packets on the left, one big packet on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left group: exactly five identical small teal (#0072B2) tea packets in a row, the place name Himachal above the row and 200 g for ₹200 under the first packet only; a bracket under all five reads ₹1000 per kg. Right group: exactly one large amber (#E69F00) tea packet, as wide as the five small ones together, the place name Meghalaya above it and 1 kg for ₹800 on it; under it ₹800 per kg. A small reddish purple (#CC79A7) tag above the left group reads more expensive. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Compare prices for the same amount: 1 kg costs ₹1000 in one place and ₹800 in the other.
